hits.about: Beach House situated in the most prime beach front location overlooking the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort, this collection of 88 apartments are modelled on the luxury of simplicity and convenience.From studio – 3-bedroom simplex and duplex apartments, the homes showcase a seamless fusion of contemporary design and timeless elegance, with meticulously crafted interiors featuring open floor plans, floor-to-ceiling windows, and bespoke finishes that create an ambiance of understated refinement.Top locations nearby:Wynn Al Marjan Island Resort - 3 minutes, Ritz Carlton Hotel - 9 minutes, Al Hamra Golf Club - 9 minutes, RAK Mall shopping center - 9 minutes, Ras Al Khaimah Airport - 30 minutes, Dubai Airport - 45 minutes.With direct views of Wynn Al Marjan Island and a close beachfront locations, investors and end users alike are expected to see a significant increase in demand contributing to a positive ROI (up to 15%).
hits.title: The Beach House
